overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long AAPL Daily ETF (AAPB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Apple stock. AAPB was launched on Aug 9, 2022 and is issued by GraniteShares.
